تلتمسوا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَمِسُوا (taltamisū) /tal.ta.mi.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# تُلْتَمَسُوا (tultamasū) /tul.ta.ma.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
